subject: Comp clearance: Evan Brooks — Staff Inference Engineer (verbal prep)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Comp clearance: Evan Brooks — Staff Inference Engineer (verbal prep)

Hi team,

Following final loop with the interview panel, I'm requesting comp / leveling clearance for Evan Brooks (resume attached). Quick summary: strong systems background (distributed inference), strong onsite loop with infra + research partners. Hiring manager recommendation: Staff (IC4).

Proposed package (initial ask from HM/benchmarked):
- Base salary: $220,000
- Equity: 0.80% (4-year, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $40,000 (split over first 2 payrolls)
- Title: Staff Inference Engineer
- Office: hybrid (SF)

Rationale for range: candidate has prior infra/serving ownership at scale, scarce LLM infra skillset, 2 competing offers (one smaller FAANG). Comp matrix attached for banding guidance.

Ask:
1) Approve leveling to Staff (IC4) or flag recategorization to Sr/Principal?
2) Approve total comp range as proposed or propose changes (particularly equity %).
3) If approved, I'll prepare a verbal offer and request legal to draft the formal offer letter.

Attachments: Evan_Brooks_Resume.pdf, Draft_Offer_Evan_Brooks.docx, comp_matrix_nov2026.xlsx

Timing: Candidate asked for a verbal in the next 48 hours — if we can sign off today/tomorrow that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp clearance: Evan Brooks — Staff Inference Engineer (verbal prep)

Jonas — thanks for the write-up and the matrix. Quick notes inline.

- Leveling: Staff (IC4) seems appropriate given scope and cross-team ownership. Fine by me.
- Base: $220k is within band for SF but on the lower end for top candidate.
- Equity: 0.80% is above our normal for IC4 in comp matrix; will need an exception approval if we want to grant >0.6%.
- Sign-on: $40k seems reasonable given competing offers.

If you want to keep base at $220k, we can escalate the equity exception and a larger sign-on. If you prefer to raise base, likely need to move some budget from sign-on or compress equity.

I can greenlight leveling and base pending Vivek's ok on equity exception. Laura — can you confirm budget runway for sign-on? Maya — any objections on leveling / title?

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp clearance: Evan Brooks — Staff Inference Engineer (verbal prep)

Thanks for the context — good candidate and seems important to secure quickly. My view: approve leveling to Staff (IC4). For comp, I'd prefer to trade toward base for retention and simplicity: approve base up to $230,000, equity at 0.70%, sign-on capped at $25,000. That keeps total cash + equity within our comp bands and avoids setting an equity-exception precedent above 0.75% for IC4.

If you (Jonas) feel equity is critical at 0.8% to beat competing offers, I will consider a one-time exception but need a short justification (candidate uniqueness + counteroffer details) and sign-off from Finance. Otherwise please proceed with the above.

I'll ask legal to prep the offer with the $230k / 0.70% / $25k sign-on, pending final confirmation from you. Laura — finance side ok with $25k sign-on?

- Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & GTM Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@gmail.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: verbal offer and timing

Evan — great to speak with you today. Thanks again for making time for our loop. We're excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood Inference. Before we send a formal offer letter, I wanted to follow up with the package we'll present verbally (final docs to follow once you confirm interest):

- Title: Staff Inference Engineer (IC4)
- Base salary: $230,000
- Equity: 0.70% (4-year vesting, 1y cliff)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time)
- Location: San Francisco hybrid
- Target start date: mid-Jan 2027 (flexible)

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call tomorrow (Fri) at 11:30am PT for a verbal offer and to walk through next steps? If that time doesn't work, propose two windows and we'll accommodate.

If you accept verbally, we'll route the formal offer through DocuSign and send benefits and relocation (if applicable) paperwork.

Attachments: Draft_Offer_Evan_Brooks.docx (internal — final will come from Legal)

Thanks — please let me know ASAP so we can lock timing.

Best,
Jonas

Redwood Inference
